title: Keep element bundle verification clean on failure and usable from spaced checkout paths
description: Keep element bundle verification clean on failure and usable from spaced checkout paths
acceptance_criteria: Matching bundles pass; stale web/package bundles, storage leakage, oversized output and compiler errors fail without modifying bundles or leaving scratch directories; checkouts containing spaces work; all seven subprocess regressions and the actual bundle check run in the existing native lane.

answers.constraints: Preserve the parser-only element bundle, the 50000-byte budget, exact published bundle bytes, source/library formats, signer policy and truthful human lifecycle boundaries; run substantive subprocess negative controls.
